items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: We were supposed to be in the record business together. He and I and Prez.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was really funny. And Lester and Vic Dickenson, they used to just keep us going all the time. Because we'd be on the bus and we'd be sleeping and we'd hear the dice clicking. They'd say, 'wake up, come on here and let's get this stuff on the road here'. They'd say, 'this is our lucky day', and they'd be the first ones broke.
